description:
#### Changed
- **Hide screenshots can now take the screenshot.** The switch only kept Instagram from telling
  the chat, while the disappearing-media window itself still refused screenshots ("This app does
  not allow screenshots") — so there was nothing for the detectors to hide. While the switch is
  on, that window stops being marked screenshot-protected. On the test phone, view-once: the
  screenshot goes through and the sender sees no notice; switch it off and the stock block
  returns. Also from HushGram (its Allow screenshots half).

---

Oxbow for Instagram 454.0.0.54.77 (patch bundle 1.3.1). Earlier patch bundles for this
version, and what they changed: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

- **oxbow.apk** replaces Instagram (uninstall Instagram first).
- **oxbow-clone.apk** installs next to Instagram.
- **patches-1.3.1.mpp**: patch Instagram yourself in [Morphe Manager](https://morphe.software): add the source `github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow`.

Obtainium: add `https://github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow` and set the APK filter to `oxbow\.apk$` or `oxbow-clone\.apk$`.
